rationale: Reference baseline and lineage root, not a candidate: the published growth law of a burner-supported spherical diffusion flame with its published constants (rhoD 0.0334 g/m/s, critical fuel flux 0.2 g/m2/s, D 28 mm2/s at 1 atm and inversely proportional to pressure) and nothing else: no establishment time, no weak class, no burner limit, no programmed stop. No number was taken from the PSI-159 tables. Data-informed candidates of acme_normal-wsp-v3 are literal revisions of this release, so that the registry records them as revisions with development exposure.
